description: Change one ready campaign variation with AI and save the result over it, like an edit in the editor: the prompt says what to change, in any language. With sectionIds only those top-level blocks change. A whole-variation edit may also give it its own emailTheme and fontFamily. Runs synchronously and can take up to a minute. Fails with 409 if the variation is not ready or changed while the AI was editing it, and with 400 when the AI changed nothing (the error explains why). Never changes the campaign email; use_campaign_variation does.

companyId.description: Company ID. If omitted, uses the currently selected company.

prompt.description: What should change, any language, up to 2000 characters.

sectionIds.description: Only change these top-level blocks. Omit to change the whole variation.

name: edit_campaign_variation

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `edit_campaign_variation` MCP tool.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

variation.description: The campaign variation record returned by Sequenzy.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
